families.name: Heading block
families.variant_boundary: Hierarchy, title width and line count; divider pages are recipes

families.name: Text/list/callout panel
families.content_zones: Heading, paragraphs or ordered bullet groups
families.variant_boundary: Border, surface, emphasis and density; retain paragraph/list structure

families.name: Icon with content
families.variant_boundary: Icon position and optical size; keep icon-to-copy association

families.name: Numbered item/card
families.variant_boundary: Horizontal/vertical arrangements and badge placement; keep numbering semantic

families.name: Metric display
families.content_zones: Value, unit, label and optional source
families.variant_boundary: Single/multiple metric arrangement; preserve value/label/source association

families.name: Quotation
families.variant_boundary: Quote length and attribution position; source claims remain explicit

families.name: Person profile
families.content_zones: Portrait, name, role and optional biography
families.variant_boundary: Compact identity versus detailed biography variants

families.name: Role tile
families.content_zones: Role label, owner and optional allocation
families.variant_boundary: Staffing/ownership colors and explicit legend; distinct from a person biography

families.name: Pod container
families.content_zones: Pod title and ordered role tiles
families.variant_boundary: Role count, columns and spacing; parent owns inter-pod relationships

families.name: Aligned table/evidence row
families.content_zones: Named columns, row heading and cell content
families.variant_boundary: Column widths, row count and row/cell styling; headers remain aligned

families.name: Process step
families.content_zones: Step label, activities, outputs and connection ports
families.variant_boundary: Step count/order belong to parent flow; local slot hierarchy stays explicit

families.name: Architecture node/tile
families.variant_boundary: Node role, width and ports; do not infer arbitrary graph topology

families.name: Architecture layer
families.content_zones: Layer label plus ordered capability tiles
families.variant_boundary: Label and tiles share row geometry; repeatable layer owns its segmentation

families.name: Cross-cutting rail
families.variant_boundary: Separate from layer labels; divider and all-layer scope must remain clear

families.name: Time axis
families.variant_boundary: Period count/width; shared axis coordinates used by all lanes

families.name: Gantt workstream lane
families.content_zones: Workstream label, activity intervals and status
families.variant_boundary: Label/bar vertical alignment, period endpoints and explicit status colors

families.name: Milestone/annotation
families.variant_boundary: Anchor and caption placement; belongs to a timeline or event sequence

families.name: Gauge or discrete rating
families.variant_boundary: Renderer geometry stays locked; do not substitute progress bars for source gauges

families.name: Legend/key item
families.variant_boundary: Actor/status/series meaning stays stable across presentation profiles

families.name: Media frame
families.variant_boundary: Separate photo, portrait, icon, logo and thumbnail aspect/crop policies

families.name: Anchored design accent
families.content_zones: Target phrase or source/target objects and approved artwork
families.variant_boundary: Underline, marker and arrow have different placement rules; no standalone slide template
